sections: Use case: deterministic polygon-authoring source image for a 2D game asset. This is a perception sample, not the final mesh.

Primary request:
Create exactly one {{subject}}, viewed from {{view}}. Its category must be immediately recognizable from the outer contour alone. Silhouette specification: {{silhouette}}. Proportions: {{proportions}}.

Color design:
Use only broad discrete subject colors from this palette description: {{palette}}. Use large contiguous flat-color regions with hard boundaries. Colors communicate material regions only; they do not simulate lighting. No subject color may equal or visually approach the background key.

Composition:
Square canvas. Center the complete subject and keep it fully inside frame. Its foreground bounding box should occupy roughly 70% to 82% of the canvas, with uninterrupted key-color padding on every side. Use one dominant connected foreground island. Keep every important extremity thick enough to survive reduction to 256 by 256 pixels.

Background:
A perfectly uniform solid {{background_key}} chroma-key field across the entire canvas, extending cleanly to the subject edge. No floor, horizon, vignette, texture, lighting variation, reflection, transparency, halo, or shadow.

Rendering style:
Clean abstract 2D game-asset authoring art, limited palette, broad connected color planes, exact orthographic presentation, and crisp hard edges. Do not draw triangulation, wireframes, polygon seams, or many decorative facets. Downstream tooling extracts only outer shape, landmark position and width, and color references; it constructs all final Polygon points and faces itself.

Hard exclusions:
No additional objects, detached particles, labels, text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, watermark, hands, stand, pedestal, environment, cast shadow, contact shadow, ambient occlusion, glow, bloom, transparency, gradients, soft airbrushing, photographic texture, scratches, grain, tiny repeated detail, perspective tilt, isometric view, or cropped parts. {{forbidden_details}}
rejection_checks: outer contour is not recognizable at 256 by 256
more than one foreground island or any detached decoration
subject touches or is cropped by the canvas edge
background is not a uniform chroma-key field
landmark is broken, branched, duplicated, low-contrast, or width-unstable
landmark depends on lighting, highlight, shadow, texture, or text
soft gradients, transparency, realism, or dense decorative facets appear
